sections.title: Turning the statement into a question
sections.content: You already know the statement form from Unit 18: lehet + infinitive says what's generally possible, with no change for person — Itt lehet parkolni ("You can park here"). Turning it into a question just needs the question intonation you already use everywhere else in Hungarian; word order doesn't change. The short answer is simply Igen, lehet. or Nem, nem lehet.

sections.title: Question and answer with lehet
rows: Is it possible to park here?
Is it possible to pay by card here?

items.english: Is it possible to take photos in the spa?

items.spanish: Elnézést, lehet itt wifit használni? Igen, ingyenes.
items.english: Excuse me, is it possible to use wifi here? Yes, it's free.

sections.content: lehet never conjugates and never takes a subject — that's exactly what makes it easy to ask about: you don't have to decide whose ability you're asking about, only whether the thing itself is possible.
